yonik-helper.service:
[Unit]
Description=Yonik — системный сетевой помощник
Documentation=https://www.freedesktop.org/software/systemd/man/systemd.kill.html
After=dbus.service
Requires=dbus.service
StartLimitIntervalSec=60
StartLimitBurst=5

[Service]
Type=dbus
BusName=cloud.highpriority.yonik.Network1
ExecStartPre=/usr/lib/yonik/yonik-helper --check-worker-fence
ExecStart=/usr/lib/yonik/yonik-helper
User=root
Group=root
UMask=0077
RuntimeDirectory=yonik
RuntimeDirectoryMode=0700
RuntimeDirectoryPreserve=yes
Restart=on-failure
RestartSec=1s
TimeoutStartSec=15s
TimeoutStopSec=5s
KillMode=control-group
KillSignal=SIGTERM
SendSIGKILL=yes
FinalKillSignal=SIGKILL
CapabilityBoundingSet=CAP_NET_ADMIN
AmbientCapabilities=
NoNewPrivileges=yes
ProtectSystem=strict
ProtectHome=yes
PrivateTmp=yes
TemporaryFileSystem=/dev/shm:rw,nosuid,nodev,noexec,mode=1777,size=64M,nr_inodes=128
PrivateDevices=yes
BindPaths=/dev/net/tun
DeviceAllow=/dev/net/tun rw
ProtectKernelTunables=yes
ProtectKernelModules=yes
ProtectKernelLogs=yes
ProtectControlGroups=yes
RestrictNamespaces=yes
RestrictAddressFamilies=AF_UNIX AF_NETLINK AF_INET AF_INET6
RestrictRealtime=yes
RestrictSUIDSGID=yes
LockPersonality=yes
MemoryDenyWriteExecute=yes
SystemCallArchitectures=native
LimitCORE=0
yonik-worker.service:
[Unit]
Description=Yonik — сетевое ядро
BindsTo=yonik-helper.service
After=yonik-helper.service

[Service]
Type=exec
User=yonik-worker
Group=yonik-worker
ExecStart=/usr/lib/yonik/yonik-worker --run
StandardInput=socket
StandardOutput=null
StandardError=null
Sockets=yonik-worker.socket
Slice=system.slice
Restart=no
KillMode=control-group
KillSignal=SIGTERM
SendSIGKILL=yes
FinalKillSignal=SIGKILL
TimeoutStartSec=10s
TimeoutStopSec=5s
UMask=0077
NoNewPrivileges=yes
CapabilityBoundingSet=CAP_NET_ADMIN
AmbientCapabilities=CAP_NET_ADMIN
PrivateNetwork=no
PrivateDevices=no
DevicePolicy=closed
DeviceAllow=/dev/net/tun rw
ProtectSystem=strict
ProtectHome=yes
PrivateTmp=yes
TemporaryFileSystem=/dev/shm:rw,nosuid,nodev,noexec,mode=1777,size=64M,nr_inodes=128
ProtectKernelTunables=yes
ProtectKernelModules=yes
ProtectKernelLogs=yes
ProtectControlGroups=yes
RestrictNamespaces=yes
RestrictRealtime=yes
RestrictSUIDSGID=yes
LockPersonality=yes
MemoryDenyWriteExecute=yes
SystemCallArchitectures=native
RestrictAddressFamilies=AF_UNIX AF_NETLINK AF_INET AF_INET6
MemoryMax=256M
TasksMax=64
LimitCORE=0
yonik-worker.socket:
[Unit]
Description=Yonik — приватный канал запуска ядра
BindsTo=yonik-helper.service
After=yonik-helper.service

[Socket]
ListenStream=/run/yonik-worker/run.sock
SocketUser=root
SocketGroup=root
SocketMode=0600
DirectoryMode=0700
Accept=no
RemoveOnStop=yes
Service=yonik-worker.service
